ranked_optimizations.title: Use mandatory final cleanup as the independent native reference

supporting_evidence.label: source_verified
supporting_evidence.claim: Optimized collector executes plain reference, captured baseline, then exact plain cleanup. Events are returned and appended only after cleanup succeeds.

supporting_evidence.label: measured_diagnostic
supporting_evidence.claim: 17 completed inputs: native baseline mean 0.943160939 s; contribution baseline 0.934311409 s; plain cleanup 0.918389543 s. Not timings of measure_input(optimized=True).

supporting_evidence.label: source_inferred
supporting_evidence.claim: Removing the initial plain reference saves exactly one full model forward per cache-miss optimized physical input: three full forwards become two. No suffix changes.

proposed_change: For optimized effects only, keep the contribution-captured baseline at current native full shapes and all eight independent suffix branches. Remove the initial pristine reference forward and its early comparison.

After hooks/overrides are removed and all branches are complete, execute the existing plain full cleanup forward. Use it as the independent reference for the captured baseline and preserve cleaned_nll == baseline plus torch.equal(cleaned_logits, captured_logits). Do not relax exact cleanup to assert_close.

No event returns or Journal.append until the final independent/exact comparison passes. On exception, restore hooks/forward overrides; leave the input incomplete and retain existing failure journal semantics.
Keep native, calibration and probe branches unchanged. Keep _input_case two independent baselines and separate full native ablations; validation overhead is intentional.

Retain shared_seconds as the measured captured-baseline/setup component, cleanup_seconds as the single final full reference, per-layer eight-effect seconds, and physical input total. Keep old timing aliases for planning consumers. Use a distinct candidate execution-mode identifier and future receipts.

operation_rationale.speedup_status: UNKNOWN until actual paired collector benchmark

ranked_optimizations.memory_consequences: Removes independent reference logits and one forward lifetime, but captures still dominate. No assumed peak-fit gain; measure allocated/reserved/RSS and whole-device telemetry. No new persistent GPU cache.
numerical_and_behavior_risks: Baseline equivalence failure is detected later, after eight branches, but still before any complete event persistence; explicitly test this delayed failure.
Existing exact cleanup is stronger than the early tolerant predictor check, but it does not replace the validator checks of local mixtures, routes, downstream coefficients and parameter integrity.
Candidate changes invalidate prior receipts/session/reuse/frozen calibration identity even when event numerical payloads match.

local_differential: Extend existing tiny 16-layer packed OLMoE fixtures for layers [15], [0,7,15] and ordering [15,0,7]; compare native, preserved optimized baseline and candidate raw routes/weight hex/baseline/all eight ablated NLLs/deltas/event IDs; exclude actual timing/resource differences.

Instrument forward dispatch: candidate has exactly two full forwards plus eight suffixes per requested layer; native/calibration/probe operation counts are unchanged. Confirm shared times are counted once per physical input.

Inject captured-baseline/logit corruption that passes individual effect construction; final native reference must reject before any Journal.append. Retain exact equality even for a discrepancy inside atol/rtol.
Test partial-layer resume, exact raw reuse, source/executor/context/token/target mismatches and timing-sidecar failure; candidate rejects old receipts and old-executor reuse.
failure_cleanup: Inject baseline expert failure, seventh suffix failure, nonfinite output and cleanup-forward failure; every expert override, routing hook, layer/residual hook is removed, parameters unchanged, subsequent plain forward recovers baseline.

No failed input creates a complete event; retain existing journal lock cleanup, torn-tail rejection and immutable sealed output behavior. Sidecar failure after successful raw event fsync remains a recorded failure with UNKNOWN missing timing on resume.

Before production, require fresh executor-specific native mechanics receipts and full_technical optimized acceptance over every accepted technical input at both contexts; frozen tolerances, exact routes/survivors/untargeted local rows and cleanup, natural downstream routes vs native ablation, unchanged parameters.
Benchmark collector wall time including persistence; do not claim speedup from counts, the partial screen or CPU fixtures.

ranked_optimizations.implementation_slice: Only this optimized measure_input scheduling change, candidate mode/receipt plumbing, differential and failure/cleanup regressions. Keep decoder math, captures, validator and science unchanged.

ranked_optimizations.title: Reuse only complete unchanged downstream expert batches at native shapes

supporting_evidence.label: source_verified
supporting_evidence.claim: Every early-layer suffix runs full native downstream attention/router/expert loops over the entire original window. Intervention is at the final input token.

supporting_evidence.label: measured_diagnostic
supporting_evidence.claim: Eight suffixes total mean 7.292339295 s at layer 0 and 3.900030723 s at layer 7, versus 0.019551334 s at layer 15. Expert-vs-attention/dispatch split unmeasured.

supporting_evidence.label: conditional_operation_count
supporting_evidence.claim: If prefix hidden bytes/routes and native expert batch layouts remain identical, experts outside the baseline/current predictor active-set union have unchanged batches. Union is at most 16 of 64; savings depend on which experts are actually hit and on exact guard success.

proposed_change: First profile native suffix attention, routing/expert GEMMs, indexing/scatter, guards and synchronization. Start a narrowly bounded prototype at layer 8 for layer-7 interventions; expand to 8..15 only after measured benefit and numerical agreement.

During one immutable per-input baseline, record downstream per-expert unweighted output, exact ordered row/slot map and complete FP32 input dependency; parameters/version and input identity remain bound. Do not reuse across windows or interventions from mutated buffers.

In each branch continue full-shape native eager attention and natural router. Reuse an expert output only when its entire input matrix, ordered row mapping and shape match the baseline exactly and parameters are unchanged; conservative mismatch recomputes the full current expert batch.

Always run changed expert batches at their actual native branch sizes and row order. Reweight with current branch coefficients and rebuild the complete mixture from zero in ascending native expert/index_add_ order. Do not subtract from baseline mixture, freeze downstream routes or compute only a predictor GEMV.

Keep use_cache=False, past_key_values=None and full original context; this cache concerns expert outputs only, not attention keys/values. Limit lifetime to one physical input; remove overrides in finally and discard buffers on all failures.

Persist per-layer hit/miss batch/row counts, guard/recompute/copy/scatter time and memory during diagnosis. If shape changes alter prefix bits, guard misses are expected and savings may vanish; no silent equality relaxation.

operation_rationale.expert_gemm_fraction_remaining_if_all_64: at most 16/64 only under exact unchanged dependency assumptions; not a latency prediction
operation_rationale.speedup_status: UNKNOWN; no measured expert/attention split or guard hit-rate

ranked_optimizations.memory_consequences: Cache unweighted expert rows costs approximately 4*W*8*H bytes/layer plus exact input/mapping and baseline buffers. For illustrative H=2048, W=4096 this is 256 MiB/layer; eight layers need 2 GiB and 15 need 3.75 GiB for outputs alone. H=2048 is a sizing example, not a verified configuration value here. Add input snapshots, masks, residuals, temporary tensors and allocator reserve. No fit claim from current 30.88GB allocated/33.07GB reserved maxima.
numerical_and_behavior_risks: Causal prefix invariance is mathematical, not FP32 bitwise proof. Changed predictor routing changes expert GEMM batch sizes and can change prefix row rounding; exact whole-input guards must catch this.
Changing scatter order, skipping a zero contribution, reduced-shape GEMV or reusing weighted outputs under changed coefficients can break frozen tolerances.
Cache guards/CPU-GPU sync and storage may cost more than recomputation; dense eager attention remains quadratic and unchanged.
Overrides must be installed only on candidate suffixes. Independent native validation must never consume accelerated cached outputs.

local_differential: Add packed-expert fixtures with stable and changed predictor expert sets, expert batch row-count changes, a predictor-only expert, coefficient ties, non-contiguous inputs and repeated branches from immutable buffers.
Compare cached output and full current native experts at identical shapes; exact row IDs/coefficient bytes/prefix checks, tolerance mixture/logits/NLL and final raw effects.
Deliberately perturb an earlier prefix hidden row, row order, shape or coefficient; prove guard miss/recompute or fail closed, never stale reuse.
Verify cache disabled for native/calibration/probe paths, stage/window isolation, mixed hit/miss branches and fallback behavior.
failure_cleanup: Inject failure at cache capture, guard, GEMM, scatter and later decoder layer; restore every override/hook and preserve parameters; release buffers and recover native baseline with no complete failed event.
native_gpu: Require separate candidate-identity full native comparison for both contexts/all domains/all eight experts/early layers, including exact downstream routes and local untargeted rows; do not reuse rank-1 acceptance.

Retain only if paired actual collector total improves beyond observed timing variation with positive memory headroom and bounded guard costs; otherwise retain full-shape fallback and reject candidate.
